aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.shield_br: Activate with your shield raised. For 3 seconds, attacks you block from the front knock you back 90% less and deal 65% less damage to the shield. You move 25% slower while braced.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.counterat: Activate within 2.5 seconds of blocking. Your next melee hit on that attacker within 3 seconds deals 70% more damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.heavy_str: Your next heavy-weapon hit within 3 seconds deals 50% more damage and interrupts a skeleton drawing its bow or an ordinary pillager loading its crossbow. Use an axe, mace, heavy blade or heavy scythe.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.slowing_s: Press Cast with a regular bow to draw and automatically release an ordinary arrow at full draw. A hit slows the target by 60% for 4 seconds.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.marking_s: Press Cast with a regular bow to draw and automatically release an ordinary arrow that marks a target in sight. Your first follow-up ordinary arrow to hit it within 7 seconds deals 70% more damage and spends the mark.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.quick_sho: Press Cast with a regular bow to draw and automatically release an ordinary arrow. The base draw takes 9 ticks instead of 20, and the arrow deals 90% of normal damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.triple_sh: Press Cast with a regular bow to start drawing. At full draw, it automatically fires three ordinary arrows in quick succession along your aim at release. The last two deal less damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.disengage: Move back up to 5 blocks along solid ground while keeping your facing. For 1.5 seconds, the first direct melee hit against you deals half damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.dash.name: Dash
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.dash.desc: Move forward up to 6 blocks along solid ground. Your next light-weapon hit within 2.5 seconds adds 35% of the strike’s normal damage.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.flank_str: Your first light-weapon hit from the side or rear within 3 seconds deals 85% more damage. Use a knife, dagger or amethyst rapier.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.shield_sh: Block an attack with your shield, then use this technique to shove the nearby attacker away.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.wide_shie: Shield Shove also pushes nearby enemies in front of you. It still requires a successful block and uses the same cooldown.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.last_stan: Survive an enemy hit that drops you to low health. For a short time, your next fully charged melee hit deals more damage. Activates automatically.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.offensive: Activate with a heavy weapon. You take more damage while the stance lasts. Each fully charged heavy-weapon hit speeds up your next heavy-weapon swing while the stance is active.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.reason.te: Block successful. You can briefly use Shield Shove.

aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.duelist_p: Activate with a light weapon just before a frontal melee hit to soften it. After a successful parry, you can make one quicker attack against the same opponent.
aeroscapes_reimagine.technique.duelist_s: Hold left or right when Duelist’s Parry succeeds to take a short step in that direction along solid ground. The parry keeps its cooldown and quicker manual reply.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.reason.te: Parried. Your next swing against this opponent is quicker.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.technique: Click a preparation slot to assign the technique. Activate it with the prepared ability controls.

Call one wolf for 60 seconds, or two with Wolf Pair. Uses the shared summon cooldown.
Call one brown bear for 60 seconds. Your group can hold one bear. Uses the shared summon cooldown.
Your summoned foxes deal 50% more damage.
Your summoned foxes take 25% less damage.
Your summoned wolves deal 50% more damage.
Your summoned wolves take 25% less damage.
Your summoned bear deals 50% more damage.
Your summoned bear takes 25% less damage.
Call your active companions back along a reachable route. You can recall them while aiming at an enemy.
Aim at a hostile creature in sight within 24 blocks and order your companions to attack it.
Your summons stay until lost or replaced. Living companions follow paid waystone travel and keep their injuries. Your death dismisses them.
